from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.HC_STAR_PATH_HUNTER, prompt_custom.HC_STAR_OBSTRUCTION_CHECKER, prompt_custom.HC_STAR_EDGE_ACCOUNTANT], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.HC_STAR_SYNTHESIZER)
        seed = await star(problem)
        shared = operator.SharedMemory(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.HC_SHARED_ANALYST_SEEDED, prompt_custom.HC_SHARED_CONSTRUCTOR_SEEDED, prompt_custom.HC_SHARED_SKEPTIC_SEEDED],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.HC_SHARED_AGGREGATOR_FORMAT_LOCK_STRICT,
        )
        solution = await shared(problem + "\n\nSeed analysis from parallel search:\n" + seed["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
